title: Lights Off for the Fledglings

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: mined tankers burn in Hormuz, Netanyahu calls Israel's vote stolen and the US braces for midterms. Small lights hold: 108 stupas rise in Bhutan, islands go dark to save seabird chicks, and sound waves take aim at brain cancer.

style.genre: darkwave — chorused guitar, tubular bells, choir, LinnDrum

lines: Two tankers burning in the strait,
the talks go on, they say,
a man calls the counting stolen,
the count stays where it lay.
On Atlantic rocks the porches dim
so the young birds find the sea,
in Bhutan they stack a hundred stones
and eight, for what might be.
Turn the lights off, Tuesday's coming,
hold the calm the way you'd hold
